name: Tapp
summary: Swabian 3-4 player trick-taking game descended from German Tarok where soloist bids to score 61+ against defenders.
rules_text: 36 French-suited cards: A,10,K,Q,J,9,8,7,6 in each suit, Ace high. Deal 11 cards each to 3 players plus 3-card tapp/talon face down. Hearts are permanent trumps in basic game. Bidding clockwise: pass, Frage (take tapp, exchange up to 3 discards, need 61 points, tapp counts for declarer), Solo/Herzsolo (play without tapp). Classic Tapp adds Suit Solo where declarer chooses trump suit. May announce Tout to win all tricks. Forehand leads, must follow suit and trump if void, no need to win trick. Highest trump or led suit wins trick, defenders share pile. 61 points wins; if 60-60 draw. Scoring is game points per card points over 60, doubled for Solo, double/triple for Tout. With pot, dealer antes, declarer wins or pays pot.
rating_reason: Specific 3-4 player trick-taking tarock variant with fixed deck
